todo.title: Simple Todo demo
todo.description: Write a todo with a safe Markdown subset. This demo is replaced when a concrete application is initialized.

errors.invalid: The todo must contain between 1 and 2,000 characters.
errors.limit: The local limit of 1,000 todos has been reached.
errors.persistence: Local storage is unavailable or contains invalid data. Check the browser privacy settings and reload the page.

settings.title: Settings
settings.privacyText: This demo stores todos in IndexedDB and preferences in localStorage in this browser. It sets no cookies and contacts no external service.
settings.confirmText: Todos and this app's saved preferences will be removed from this browser. This cannot be undone.
settings.privacyEntryHint: What is stored, and how to delete it

privacy.title: Privacy-friendly start
privacy.body: This app sets no cookies. It loads no analytics, remote fonts, or external connectors and only stores the local data described in Settings.

intro.welcomeBody: This application was built from the LumbreCode web template. Three short steps show what it does.
intro.settingsBody: Both can be changed at any time in the settings, and are stored in this browser only.

privacyPanel.title: Privacy and data
privacyPanel.localTitle: Your data stays in this browser
privacyPanel.localBody: The application stores its content in IndexedDB and its preferences in this browser’s local storage. There is no account, no server and no background transfer. What you delete here is gone.
privacyPanel.deleteDataHint: Clears all content. Your preferences are kept.
privacyPanel.resetSettingsHint: Language, appearance and every other preference back to its default. Your content is kept.
privacyPanel.resetConfirmText: Every preference returns to its default. Your content is kept.

diagnostics.intro: Every registered preference with its raw stored value. Read-only.
